name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses trace to the task. Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) with the hard Existence(has_door_key) captures 'move the ball away before you take the key' and forces taking the key; the soft Precedence(door_open, key_lost) captures 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' (the ban ends once the door opens, matching 'until/open'); the soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) captures the 'whenever holding the key, have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards' preference; and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) with the hard Existence(target_picked_up) captures 'open the door, then pick up the box'. Priorities match the wording ('try not to' soft, commands hard).

Pick up the box in the other room.
